topic: Data migration and calibration checks for Latvia/UK
summary_markdown:
The session covered the migration of data for Latvia and UK locations to production. Initial steps included retrieving specific location details (e.g., 80 calibration level sites) for Latvia.

Regarding technical checks, it was discussed that while calibration generally applies to sessions, a separate table exists for calibrations. A function structure was provided to check calibration status across staging and production environments using `is_prod` parameterization.

Specific actions were taken to migrate Latvia from staging to production (starting 2022-09-01). Subsequently, the process was extended to UK locations (specifically mentioning 'UK Esben').

Later, a data quality issue was identified for Latvia, where data for one sensor appeared missing around midnight on November 15th. The technical investigation confirmed an apparent gap in the raw device sighting buffer records.
decisions: Latvia data will be migrated from staging to production starting 2022-09-01.
The process was extended to include UK locations.
action_items: Follow up with the appropriate team member (Nastya) regarding the missing single sensor data points for Latvia around midnight on 2022-11-15.
